text:
tess: quick follow-up from the pricing Q&A: if a trial customer hits quota mid-request, what's the UX? block immediately or allow finish?

harry: short: we allow in-flight requests to finish when within the grace window, then start returning quota_exceeded 429s. the grace window for trials is conservative (default 2m).

tess: ok. do we ever auto-upgrade trials if they try to buy more mid-flow? sales asked.

nora: no auto-charge. console shows a modal with upgrade options and an email. paid accounts with card on file can opt into auto-topup (opt-in only).

tess: are tokens + embeddings the same quota or separate? customers ask a lot about this.

harry: separate by default. promo bundles may create pooled credits but that's a special billing flag.

vp-finance: small finance note: promo credits reduce invoice balance only. mapping credits->quota is manual and audit-logged when applied. we're exploring limited self-serve for vetted accounts.

tess: error payloads - can we standardize so SDKs show consistent messages?

harry: agreed. proposal: 429 rate limit -> {"error":"rate_limited","retry_after":int}. 429 quota -> {"error":"quota_exceeded","quota_type":"tokens|embeddings","grace_remaining":int}. 402 -> {"error":"insufficient_funds"}. SDKs should interpret grace_remaining>0 as "show upgrade CTA".

tess: can we also return a small header with remaining quota for the key owner? mobile team wants to show tokens-left.

nora: proposing opt-in header: X-Redwood-Remaining: tokens=12345;embeddings=80. header only returned when enabled by org admin and only to requests signed with the org secret. also adding GET /v1/orgs/:id/usage for admin clients.

harry: plus webhooks for org alerts at 80/95/100%. payload will include org_id, quota_type, percent_used, timestamp, and admin_console_url. useful for CS automation.

tess: what about Dedicated customers? do they follow this same model?

nora: Dedicated maps quotas to committed capacity per contract. we still support grace config + headers/webhooks but defaults are tighter and SRE owns emergency scaling.

harry: small snippet for docs we can paste later:

HTTP/1.1 429 Too Many Requests
Content-Type: application/json
{
  "error": "quota_exceeded",
  "quota_type": "tokens",
  "grace_remaining": 90,
  "admin_url": "https://console.redwood.com/orgs/ORG123/billing"
}

(tess: that's perfect, thanks)

vp-finance: follow-up items: #8200 billing:promo-to-quota-policy, #8201 api:quota-header-docs, #8202 onboarding:quota-webhooks

all-hands-bot: Reminder: recording + slides posted to #all-hands; follow-ups created: 8200, 8201, 8202

tess: thanks everyone. i'll add these notes to the all-hands doc and tag CS + mobile for the header opt-in.
